svg.title: Solutions of the isothermal wind equation
svg.desc: Curves of v/c_iso against r/r_c, from 0 to 4, for different values of the integration constant. Two critical solutions cross at r = r_c, v = c_iso, marked by a dot. The wind, a thick black line, starts subsonic near the star, accelerates and becomes supersonic at r_c, and keeps accelerating slowly. The accretion solution, a thick red dashed line, is subsonic at large radii and supersonic inside r_c. Thin grey curves show the other solutions: some are subsonic everywhere, with a maximum of v at r_c; some are supersonic everywhere, with a minimum of v at r_c; others are double valued, either at small radii, where the velocity reaches c_iso with an infinite slope before r_c, or at large radii, where they never reach r_c.

g.font-family: 'Latin Modern Math', 'STIX Two Math', 'Cambria Math', serif
